content: scikit-fda representation layer: FData (abstract base), FDataGrid (non-parametric, discretized on grid), FDataBasis (parametric, linear combination of basis functions), FDataIrregular (sparse/irregular observations, added in 0.10.0). Basis types: BSplineBasis, FourierBasis, MonomialBasis, ConstantBasis, CustomBasis for R→R; TensorBasis, FiniteElementBasis for Rn→R; VectorValuedBasis for Rn→Rm. SplineInterpolation for evaluating FDataGrid at arbitrary points. Extrapolation: BoundaryExtrapolation, ExceptionExtrapolation, FillExtrapolation, PeriodicExtrapolation. Converters for irregular→basis: MinimizeMixedEffectsConverter, EMMixedEffectsConverter. FDataGrid supports arithmetic operations, derivatives (finite differences or via basis), integration, inner products. FDataBasis supports analytical derivatives. Grid-to-basis conversion via FDataGrid.to_basis(). Version 0.10.1 is current stable.
